scenes.summary: Rosa is extremely worried. Her lover, Romano, is trapped in Landbreaker territory. She asks if you could go there and find her love.

lines.text: *Sigh* Romano ... my love ... please be safe...
I'm Rosa... Please help me! My poor love is trapped in breaker territory!
He's definitely there! Look! These signals pinpoint his location...
He's constantly sending these location signals to me. I've been tracking... Ahem. I've been looking for him for days!
Here, I'll mark it on your map... I beg you! Please bring my Romano back to me...

options: People are still trapped in that place?
Is there something I can help you with?

r: Is there something I can help you with?
People are still trapped in that place?

scenes.summary: You return the watch to Rosa. She intends to keep looking for her love and bring him home.

lines.text: You're back! What happened?
What...? You can't be serious... Are you sure it's...
But this is the watch I gave him... No... This can't be happening... Why?
I can't leave him there like this. I'm ... I'm going to bring his body back...
Thank you, but I must do this. He ... he was my love... I can't simply abandon him.
Not coming back? How? But ... but I love him so much...
How is he doing? Is he hurt?
Okay. That's good to hear.
Thank you. I won't need anything else. I got a private business to settle with him.

options: I found this from a dead body.
He's not coming back and wants to return the watch.
He went to an LB turf. It was a bad mistake.
I advise against it. It's a dangerous place.

r: I found this from a dead body.
He went to an LB turf. It was a bad mistake.
I advise against it. It's a dangerous place.

scenes.summary: You meet Romano and he gives you another story. Rosa isn't his lover and she secretly planted a tracker in his watch. The man refuses to head back and asks you to return the watch to Rosa.

lines.text: AAAHHHH!!! DON'T KILL ME!
Yeah, I'm Romano, but I have a lover? I'm sing... Wait. Rosa! She asked you to come here, right?
How did she find me? I thought I'm already out in the middle of nowhere!
ARGH! Bugger this blight! She must have planted a tracker on me! I knew it! It must be the watch!!
I'm NEVER GOING BACK! I'd rather starve to death!
You don't know how loco she is. I can't live like this anymore! I really need a normal life!
Erm, just take this watch and tell her to stop looking for me... Give her an excuse ... like ... I got killed by Landbreakers and they ate everything...

options: Romano, right? Your lover is looking all over the place for you...
You sure? She seems to care a lot for you.

r: Romano, right? Your lover is looking all over the place for you...
